title: Appointed as Assistant
original: You want me to do something so boring...? Fine, fine. I'll tag along, just because you're somewhat amusing.

title: Talk 1
original: Don't count on me to move stuff. I'm not that brand of Forte.

title: Talk 2
original: This is some insanely precise instrumentation... Wait, haven't I seen these before? Oh, right. If that Mayer girl shows up, don't tell her where I am.

title: Talk 3
original: Never seen the equipment on my back before? Right, come over, put your hand here... keh-ka-hahahahahah! Look at your pathetic face! Guess what just sprayed out? It's water!—With a few... extras. Don't bother asking what!

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: My interest in helping others is zip. But boosting efficiency benefits everybody.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Battles finish up faster now. Good to know, I guess.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Cake? Soft and squishy—not my speed. But. Mmp, mmnm... the umeboshi on top's not bad, sure.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: No rain inside the landship? Duh, obviously I know that. But you never know how it might go outside. Hmph, next time there's a storm, stick close to me. You'll be glad I'm holding this.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Hey. Fancy a desert day trip? I can guide you around there. Or anywhere else you like, as long as I have my multi-function jetpack, following the scent of the wind... heh, you're incredibly lucky to have a guide like me.

title: Idle
original: You out cold? Hehe, then I've got a trick to try. Higher pressure, wider spray... And you're past the statute of limitations for a complaint.

title: Onboard
original: You the Doctor? They all say you're the one here who knows more than the rest. You're gonna let me figure that out.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Combat's just like crossing the desert, where experience means nothing. Your only need is survival instincts.

title: Promotion 1
original: Doesn't this elite medal do anything at all? No fun to be had here.

title: Promotion 2
original: Medical professional? Funny thing to call me that. Anyway, it's all about getting my job done, either way, right?

title: Added to Squad
original: Out for field work again? Fine. You're helping me test new equipment when we get back.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Leading a team in combat is close enough to being a guide.

title: Depart
original: Route, okay. Equipment, check. Let's go.

title: Begin Operation
original: Boring... Worse than running into a sandstorm.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Speak up.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: I'm thinking...

title: Deployment 1
original: Good. Efficiency up seventeen percent.

title: Deployment 2
original: Need to move faster.

title: In Battle 1
original: Even faster.

title: In Battle 2
original: Time to test my upgraded equipment.

title: In Battle 3
original: How's the new nutritional paste taste?

title: In Battle 4
original: Scent of the wind's changed...

title: 4-star Result
original: Ugh. The sandstorms I've seen beat this any day.

title: 3-star Result
original: Scraped by, huh. Wasn't a waste of time after all.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Efficiency lacking. Gotta head back and adjust my equipment, or switch reagents, maybe.

title: Operation Failure
original: At least you figured a good retreat route…

title: Assigned to Facility
original: You have a lot of rooms, huh…

title: Tap
original: You gotta stop with the boring crap already.

title: Trust Tap
original: Wanna try touching my bag again? Won't hit you in the face this time. Promise.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Wishing you a Happy New Year! I look forward to your kind guidance in the coming year. Okay, done. Without a hitch, right? Happy now?—a bonus? For me? Really? Hmm... thank you. Happy New Year.

title: Greeting
original: Rain again. Nice weather, huh, Doctor?

title: Birthday
original: Happy birthday. Here's this umbrella's for you. I bought it from a trustworthy merchant in Sargon—It's top-notch. You'll be traveling all over the place, so it'll come in handy. Oh, and if you feel like jumping off the ship's bridge with it, I won't stop you.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I've checked Rhodes Island's navigation log. You've been down some awfully treacherous routes. But why don't I see even a hint of fear in anybody? What talent do you have, as the one who guides the ship, to bring out such deep, unshakable trust? I'm... curious.
